messages.subject: MSstats / Skyline v3.7 bug?
parts:
Hi,

I would appreciate any insight you can offer on this. I suspect it started when I upgraded from v3.6 to v3.7 a few days ago, or when MSStats was updated.

On a fresh install of Skyline 3.7, plus MSStats via the 'External Tools' dialog, I try to run a 'Data Processing' job over with the default options (Equalize medians, 'Allow missing peaks'=false, 'Select high quality features'=false, width=10, height=10). 

This launches the following command:

"C:\Program Files\R\R-3.4.0\bin\R.exe" -f "C:\Users\joan\AppData\Local\Apps\2.0\CDG0R70E.B57\GEGDAM97.VYO\skyl..tion_e4141a2a22107248_0003.0006_490e9c75fc7c775b\Tools\MSstats_external_3.8.2\MSStatsQC.r" --slave --args "C:\Users\joan\AppData\Local\Temp\MSstats_Data_Processing_MSstats_Input.csv" 1 FALSE FALSE FALSE 10 10

But I get this error:

 ================================================================
 ** Loading the required statistical software packages in R ..... 
 
 =======================================
 ** Reading the data for MSstats..... 
Peptides, that are used in more than one proteins, are removed.
** Truncated peaks are replaced with NA.
** For DDA datasets, three isotopic peaks per feature and run are summed.
Some ProductCharge have no value. Please check "Result Grid" in View. 

Error in runQC() : 

 Can't finish analysis.

This is unexpected to me because it used to run fine, and there is no ProductCharge column to begin with.... Or am I missing anything obvious?

Thanks in advance,

Marina

Thank you for reporting this issue. We fixed this issue and updated in Skyline external tool. It should be v3.8.3.

- Meena
